scope: New synthetic holdout; protocol qualification, not a representative external corpus
license: MIT (SymQ-generated circuits; no third-party circuit copies)
old_blind_corpus_status: explored historical development evidence; never a new holdout

measurement_contracts.public_api_end_to_end: Actual installed verification API on existing Circuit IR; internal conversion/setup/decision/witness replay included. Symbolic service uses installed make_algebra/simulate/to_anf. Input IR generation, independent validation, startup and IPC excluded and reported separately; internal phase attribution unavailable (null).
measurement_contracts.task_service_end_to_end: Declared staged adapter service including input IR construction, conversion, setup, simulation/decision, comparison, required witness and replay, and requested ANF export. Independent validation and worker startup excluded.
measurement_contracts.precompiled_service: Same staged adapter service minus the measured tool-conversion phase only. Includes setup and IR construction; NOT a pure kernel measurement.
measurement_contracts.counterexample: Requires an actually returned concrete witness and replay. QCEC exposes no witness through this adapter and is unsupported for this service, while its positive-equivalence decision remains eligible.
measurement_contracts.independent_validation: Exhaustive scalar gate evaluation up to 10 wires; measured separately and required for common-verified timing ratios.
measurement_contracts.resources: Linux parent polls RSS/CPU every 10 ms; hard address-space and CPU backstops in worker. Verification wall admission starts at ready checkpoint; whole-worker wall limit separately includes imports and IPC. OS scheduling can add termination latency.
